newsitem.title: USA: Drypers stake cut by Triad Ventures group.
newsitem.headline: Drypers stake cut by Triad Ventures group.

text.p: A group including Triad Ventures Ltd II L.P. said Thursday it reduced its stake in Drypers Corp to 5.31 percent or 371,525 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 162,500 shares of Drypers betrween August 7 to December 13.
The group previously held a 7.65 percent stake in Drypers, a Houston-based manufacturer of disposable baby diapers and related products.
The stake is held for investment and includes 350,000 shares which the group may acquire on conversion of Dyrpers preferred stock, according to the filing.
